items.name: NVIDIA GTC Berlin 2026 (keynote Oct 21)
items.summary: NVIDIA's Europe AI conference runs Oct 20-22; Jensen Huang's Oct 21 keynote focused on AI factories, agent security and open models.
items.details: Virtual viewing is free with no registration. In the Oct 21 keynote (briefly interrupted by Greenpeace protesters) Huang announced DSX POD, a factory-built, containerized Vera Rubin AI data center that NVIDIA says partners will deliver from early 2027; the OpenShell reference architecture for running AI agents safely; a reference humanoid robot, Agile ONE SN; and new open models, including Nemotron 3.5 Super VL and Nemotron 3.5 Bolt 74B-A9B (both available now) and the 4GB Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B, which NVIDIA released on Oct 23 on Hugging Face and build.nvidia.com (an 8B-parameter, 4B-effective model post-trained from Gemma 4 E4B, with 64K context and tool calling). No consumer GeForce GPUs were announced.

items.name: Honor Win 2 series (China launch)
items.summary: Honor launched the fan-cooled Win 2 gaming phone in China from 5,499 yuan, alongside the Win RT 2, Win Turbo 2 and its first Win gaming tablet.
items.details: Announced Oct 21 with the Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6, a 6.89-inch 1440p 185Hz OLED screen (10,000 nits peak), a 10,100mAh battery with 100W wired and 80W wireless charging, two built-in fans (a 20,000rpm cross-flow fan and a 31,000rpm side fan), a 200MP main camera, a 12MP ultrawide, a 50MP selfie camera, IP68/IP69/IP69K ratings and MagicOS 11 on Android 17; it is 8.5mm thick and about 237g. Five memory options: 12/256GB for 5,499 yuan, 16/256GB for 5,799, 12/512GB for 6,299, 16/512GB for 6,999 and 16GB/1TB for 7,999. The Win Tablet has an 8.4-inch 240Hz OLED, the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5, a 10,000mAh battery and a 15,000rpm fan, from 4,199 yuan. Honor also announced the Win RT 2 and Win Turbo 2; we have not verified their final specs. No launch outside China has been announced.

items.name: OPPO Find X10 and Find X10 Pro Max (global launch)
items.date_label: Oct 21, 2026 (global launch); Europe deliveries from Nov 2
items.price: EUR 1,499 (Find X10) and EUR 1,799 (Pro Max), 12GB/512GB, Finland
items.summary: OPPO launched the Find X10 and Find X10 Pro Max globally on Oct 21 at EUR 1,499 and EUR 1,799, with European pre-orders open and deliveries from Nov 2.
items.details: Finnish pricing published at launch: Find X10 12GB/512GB EUR 1,499 and Find X10 Pro Max 12GB/512GB EUR 1,799, about EUR 500 more than last year's Find X9 equivalents, with pre-order discounts of at least EUR 100 and EUR 200 and deliveries starting Nov 2; a Hasselblad Teleconverter Kit costs EUR 499. The European models have a 7,150mAh battery (8,000mAh in China), 80W wired and 50W wireless charging, IP66/IP68/IP69 ratings and ColorOS 17 on Android 17. The Pro Max has three 200MP rear cameras (main, ultrawide and 3x telephoto) and the 2nm Dimensity 9600 Pro; the Find X10 pairs 200MP main and telephoto cameras with a 50MP ultrawide. In the Benelux, OPPO's store opened balance payments at 17:00 CEST on Oct 21; Singapore pre-orders open Oct 22 with deliveries from Oct 26; India gets its launch Oct 22. There is no US launch.

items.name: Final Fantasy Resonance
items.summary: Square Enix's first HD-2D Final Fantasy, a turn-based RPG, launched Oct 22 on Switch 2, Switch, PS5 and Xbox; the Steam version follows Oct 23.
items.details: Square Enix confirmed the Oct 22 launch on Nintendo Switch 2, Nintendo Switch, PS5, Xbox Series X|S and Xbox on PC, with the Steam version a day later on Oct 23. It is based on the first story arc of the mobile game Final Fantasy Brave Exvius, rebuilt as a console RPG, and party members can summon 'Visions', echoes of characters from across the series. Square Enix lists $49.99 for the standard edition, $59.99 for the Digital Deluxe Edition and $209.99 for the Collector's Edition.

items.name: Nintendo Switch Sports Resort
items.summary: Nintendo's motion-control sports game launched on Switch 2 on Oct 22, set on Wuhu Island with 12 sports.
items.details: Nintendo lists 12 sports, including new Thumb Wrestling and Skateboarding plus returning favorites like bowling, archery, table tennis and Power Cruising, with free-roam activities such as the prop plane. It supports 1-4 players on one system and 2-16 online, and is exclusive to Nintendo Switch 2.

items.name: iPhone Duo (Apple's first foldable)
items.summary: Apple's first foldable iPhone went on sale Oct 23 in the US and 70+ other markets from $1,999; 28 more follow Oct 30.
items.details: Launch-day pre-orders began arriving on Oct 23 (Australia and New Zealand first), and Apple Stores opened with limited walk-in stock in the US, UK, Canada, Australia, Mexico and several European countries; in China, France, Hong Kong, India, Japan, South Korea and a few other markets buyers need an online pickup reservation. Apple limits US purchases to two per customer. New online orders still quote late January 2027, so store pickup slots (Apple says to check back from Oct 24) are the best bet this year. It has a 7.6-inch folding screen, a 5.4-inch outer screen and the A20 Pro chip, in Star White and Night Sky; storage runs from 256GB ($1,999) to 2TB ($3,199). Reviews were mixed to positive (The Verge: fun but messy and expensive; Engadget: 8.8/10). Apple Pencil (USB-C) support arrives with iOS 27.2, expected around Oct 26. Early problems: 9to5Mac counted about ten owners whose inner screens cracked along the hinge line within a day or two (Apple Stores have mostly swapped them), JerryRigEverything's durability test ended with dust in the hinge and a dead inner screen, and Verizon is giving delayed pre-order customers a $100 gift card. Teardowns show two battery cells totaling 4,883 mAh.

items.name: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4
items.summary: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 launched in full on Oct 23 at midnight local time on PS5, Xbox, PC and Switch 2.
items.details: Activision released the game worldwide on Oct 23 on Xbox Series X|S, Xbox on PC, PS5, Battle.net, Steam and Nintendo Switch 2, with multiplayer and DMZ servers going live at launch and launch patch notes posted. Digital pre-orders had Campaign Early Access from Oct 16 and DMZ Early Access from Oct 20. It is a standalone purchase and will not join Game Pass until holiday 2027. PC Gamer reports a 115GB install. Season 1 follows shortly after launch and brings MW4 content into Warzone.

items.name: BYD Qin Plus (3rd generation, China)
items.summary: BYD launched the third-generation Qin Plus DM-i plug-in hybrid sedan in China on Oct 27 from 79,900 yuan, with up to 220 km of electric range.
items.details: Three DM-i versions went on sale Oct 27: 140 km Leading (79,900 yuan), 220 km Beyond/Superior (90,900 yuan) and 220 km Excellence (100,900 yuan), each 3,000 yuan cheaper for a limited time, so the effective start is 76,900 yuan. It keeps BYD's fifth-generation DM hybrid system, raises CLTC electric range to 220 km (210 km before), claims up to 2,290 km of combined range and offers God's Eye B driver assistance with roof LiDAR on some trims. The body grows to 4,840 mm on a 2,800 mm wheelbase. CnEVPost notes Qin family sales were down about 55% year on year in the first nine months. Filings also list a pure-EV version, which has not launched yet.

items.name: MacBook Pro with PROLED XDR Display (14- and 16-inch, OLED touchscreen)
items.summary: Apple's first touchscreen MacBook Pros (14- and 16-inch PROLED XDR, M5 Pro/Max) are on sale from Nov 6, from $2,899.
items.details: Unveiled by CEO John Ternus at Apple's 'Pro and tell' event in Los Angeles on Oct 28. The tandem OLED panel offers up to 2,000 nits peak brightness, a 10,000,000:1 contrast ratio, 10-120Hz ProMotion and P3 plus Adobe RGB color, with the touch sensor built into the panel; macOS 27 adds touch gestures and a Dynamic Island for Spotlight, Live Activities and Siri AI. It uses the existing M5 Pro and M5 Max (not M6), with up to 128GB of memory and storage now up to 16TB, a six-speaker system Apple says has 50% deeper bass, a new hinge for touch, and the glowing Apple logo returns on the lid. The 14-inch weighs about 3 pounds and the 16-inch about 4; Apple rates battery life at up to 24 hours. Base models start with 24GB of memory and 1TB of storage. Reuters says the 16-inch M5 Max starts at $4,799, and a fully specced model costs $14,549 (The Verge). Pre-orders opened Oct 28 in 30 countries and regions, with availability from Friday, Nov 6. The mini-LED MacBook Pros stay on sale. This settles the rumor in our tracker, which resolved true. As of Oct 29, AppleInsider reports 14-inch models ship Nov 6; adding nano-texture to the 16-inch moves delivery to Nov 7. Update Nov 6: MacRumors reports the PROLED touchscreen MacBook Pros are available to buy today. Many online configurations still show 2-3 week shipping, so Apple Stores are the faster option for base configs; Australia and New Zealand saw the first customer deliveries as Nov 6 began there.

items.name: vivo X500 Pro and X500 Pro Max (Europe launch)
items.price: X500 Pro from €1,399; X500 Pro Max from €1,599
items.summary: vivo launched the X500 Pro and X500 Pro Max in Europe on Oct 27, from €1,399 and €1,599, with launch discounts and free extras until Nov 30.
items.details: Both run MediaTek's 2nm Dimensity 9600 Pro. The Pro Max has a 200MP ZEISS APO telephoto camera and supports a 400mm-equivalent clip-on teleconverter; the smaller Pro has a 6.36-inch screen. The standard X500 is not part of the European launch. It launched at an event in Tenerife on Oct 27. List prices: X500 Pro 12GB/256GB €1,399 and 12GB/512GB €1,599; X500 Pro Max 12GB/256GB €1,599, 12GB/512GB €1,799 and 12GB/1TB €2,199 (1TB only through vivo's own store). European models all have 12GB of RAM. Early-bird offers (lower launch prices in some countries, a registration voucher, the camera grip with the Pro Max or vivo Headphones Studio with the Pro) run until Nov 30; exact deals vary by country.

items.name: Google Fitbit Edge
items.summary: Google's screen-equipped Fitbit Edge tracker went on sale on Oct 27 at $179.99, with GPS and Fitbit's first user-replaceable battery.
items.details: Pre-orders opened Oct 12. It has a larger OLED display, built-in GPS, ECG and skin-temperature sensors, up to seven days of battery life and Fitbit's first replaceable battery. There is no NFC payments, microphone or speaker, and it uses a new band system that doesn't fit older Fitbit or Pixel Watch bands. Update Oct 27: it is now on shelves at the Google Store and Best Buy, with three months of Google Health Premium included ($9.99 a month after). Google's design post lists four finishes: Obsidian, Olive, Canyon and Fog.

items.name: Minecraft (Nintendo Switch 2 version)
items.summary: Minecraft's native Switch 2 version, with Vibrant Visuals, came out on Oct 27; it's a free upgrade for digital owners of the Switch version until Jan 31, 2027.
items.details: Listed in Nintendo's October 2026 release roundup and out on Oct 27. It runs natively on Switch 2 with the Vibrant Visuals graphics mode, carries over worlds from the original Switch version and includes the Super Mario Mash-Up Pack. Players who own the original Switch version digitally can claim the Standard Edition for free through Jan 31, 2027; owners of the physical cartridge have to buy it.

items.name: Huawei Pura 90 Plus (China)
items.summary: Huawei launched the Pura 90 Plus in China on Oct 28 with the Kirin 9025 and a 1-inch-type variable-aperture main camera, from 5,499 yuan; open sales start Oct 31.
items.details: Launched at Huawei's 'Double 11' event on Oct 28. Prices: 5,499 yuan (12GB/256GB), 5,999 yuan (512GB) and 6,999 yuan (1TB), with up to 300 yuan off during the Double 11 promotion (from 5,199 yuan) until Nov 30; open sales start Oct 31 at 10:08. It sits between the Pura 90 and Pura 90 Pro. Specs per Huawei and GSMArena: Kirin 9025 (Huawei claims about 20% faster than the Kirin 9020), a 6.8-inch LTPO OLED (2848x1276, 1-120Hz) with curved sides and second-gen Kunlun Glass, a 50MP 1-inch-type main camera with f/1.4-4.0 variable aperture, a 48MP 4x telephoto that doubles as macro, a 40MP ultrawide, a 13MP selfie camera, a 5,700mAh battery with 100W wired and 80W wireless charging, IP68/69, satellite connectivity and HarmonyOS 7. Colors: Sunset Purple, Dawn Gold, Snowy White and Obsidian Black.

items.name: Huawei Enjoy 100 series (China)
items.price: Enjoy 100 from 1,399 yuan; Pro from 1,799; Pro Max from 1,999
items.summary: Huawei launched the Enjoy 100, 100 Pro and 100 Pro Max budget phones in China on Oct 28, from 1,399 yuan, with Kirin 8-series chips and big batteries.
items.details: Launched at Huawei's Oct 28 'Double 11' event with HarmonyOS 7. Enjoy 100: Kirin 8000S, 6,100mAh battery, 128GB (1,399 yuan) or 256GB (1,699 yuan), on sale Oct 31. Enjoy 100 Pro (from 1,799 yuan): 6.7-inch 120Hz OLED, Kirin 8020A, 50MP RYYB main camera, 32MP selfie camera, 6,100mAh with 40W charging. Enjoy 100 Pro Max (from 1,999 yuan): 6.84-inch 120Hz OLED rated up to 8,000 nits peak, 8,800mAh battery with 40W charging, Kirin 8020A on 128GB/256GB and Kirin 8020 on 512GB, 8MP selfie camera. The Pro models are on sale now. Earlier reports also named an Enjoy 100m; we have not seen its launch details.

items.name: Phantom Blade Zero
items.summary: S-Game's martial-arts action game launched Oct 29 on PS5 and PC to strong reviews.
items.details: Out Oct 29 on PS5 and PC (Steam). Reviews are positive, praising the combat, bosses and visuals, with complaints about technical issues on PC; the developer has advised NVIDIA users not to install the latest GeForce driver. Digital Foundry recommends Performance mode on PS5.

items.name: Samsung W27 (China)
items.summary: Samsung and China Telecom launched the China-only W27, a luxury Galaxy Z Fold 8 Ultra, on Oct 29 from 18,999 yuan; sales start Nov 13.
items.details: Launched Oct 29 at Samsung and China Telecom's annual W-series ('Heart of the World') event. IT Home says it is built on the Galaxy Z Fold 8 Ultra: Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 for Galaxy, an 8-inch inner and 6.5-inch outer screen, a triple rear camera with a 200MP main sensor and a 5,000mAh battery, in a two-tone design with a gold-finished frame, in blue and red. Ifeng lists 215 g and 4.1 mm unfolded. Prices are 18,999 yuan for 16GB/512GB and 21,999 yuan for 16GB/1TB. Registration opened Oct 29 and sales start on all channels on Nov 13. It is sold only in China.

items.name: HomePod mini (2nd generation)
items.summary: Apple's second-generation HomePod mini went on sale Oct 30 for $149 in five colors; its headline Siri AI feature arrives in a later software update.
items.details: Announced Oct 13 at Apple's 'Welcome Home' event alongside the HomeView hub and a new Apple TV 4K. It reached Apple Stores and the first pre-order customers on Oct 30 in the US and more than 23 other countries and regions, in white, midnight, pink, green and blue, and needs HomePod software 27.2. Siri AI, which Apple built the launch around, is not available yet: Apple says it comes in a future software update, in English only at first, with no date. The $149 price is $20 above the first-generation model after Apple's June price increase.

items.name: Apple Intelligence beta in China
items.date_label: Nov 3, 2026 US / Nov 4 China (developer beta; public with iOS 27.3 in December)
items.summary: The first Apple Intelligence features for China are now in testing: Apple switched them on in the iOS 27.3 developer beta on Nov 3 (US time), with a public release planned for December.
items.details: Tim Cook said on Oct 15 that a beta would reach China in October; it did not. On Oct 31 (China time) Apple's China Newsroom said testing starts Nov 4 with the latest iOS developer beta, which MacRumors expects to be iOS 27.3 beta 1, likely Nov 3 in the US. The first wave is iPhone-only (iPhone 15 Pro and later, iPhone Air, iPhone Duo) with Siri and device language set to English or Simplified Chinese, and covers Live Translation, Writing Tools, Visual Intelligence, Clean Up, Genmoji, notification and mail summaries, Priority Notifications, Smart Reply and Type to Siri. Alibaba's Qwen plugs into Siri, Writing Tools and Visual Intelligence. Siri AI, Image Playground and the newer WWDC 2026 features are not included, and Mac, iPad and other devices wait on further approvals. Update Nov 3: as of early morning Pacific time Apple had not yet posted the iOS 27.3 beta (Apple's developer releases page still tops out at iOS 27.2); MacRumors expects it later on Nov 3. Separately, Apple is testing a bug-fix iOS 27.2.1. Update Nov 4: Apple released iOS 27.3 beta 1 on Nov 3 (Nov 4 in China), and developers in China can now turn on Apple Intelligence. Per MacRumors, the beta includes Live Translation, Writing Tools (with Qwen-powered text generation), Visual Intelligence, Clean Up, Genmoji, Photos search and memory movies, Mail and notification summaries, Notes audio summaries, call transcripts, Type to Siri, and Siri handing harder questions to Qwen. Siri AI, the Siri app and the newer iOS 27 features are still excluded. A public beta and the December launch are next.

items.name: iQOO Neo12 (China)
items.summary: iQOO launched the fan-cooled Neo12 in China on Oct 28 with the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 and a 9,000mAh battery, from 4,399 yuan; sales started right away.
items.details: Prices: 4,399 yuan (12GB/256GB), 4,799 (16/256), 5,099 (12/512), 5,499 (16/512) and 6,499 (16GB/1TB); launch and platform discounts until Nov 3 plus China's national subsidy cut the entry price to 3,149 yuan where eligible. Specs: Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 with iQOO's Q3 gaming chip, an active cooling fan plus vapor chamber, a 6.83-inch 2K 185Hz AMOLED (up to 2,200 nits), a 9,000mAh battery with 100W wired charging, a 50MP main camera (Sony IMX921, OIS), 8MP ultrawide, 16MP selfie camera, 3D ultrasonic fingerprint sensor and OriginOS 7 (Android 17). iQOO has not confirmed a global version.

items.name: OnePlus Ace 7 and Ace 7 Pro (China)
items.price: Ace 7 from 4,399 yuan; Ace 7 Pro from 4,799 yuan
items.summary: OnePlus launched the fan-cooled Ace 7 (from 4,399 yuan) and Ace 7 Pro (from 4,799 yuan) in China on Oct 29, both with 9,000mAh batteries and 200MP main cameras.
items.details: Launched and on sale in China on Oct 29. The Ace 7 uses a Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 'V series' chip and the Ace 7 Pro the full Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5. Both have a 6.78-inch 1.5K LTPO screen (165Hz system-wide, 185Hz in games), a built-in dual-airflow fan, a 9,000mAh battery with 100W charging and bypass charging, a 200MP main camera, a 16MP selfie camera, IP66/68/69/69K ratings and ColorOS 17. The Pro adds a 50MP 3.5x periscope telephoto; the standard model gets an 8MP ultrawide instead. Ace 7 prices: 4,399 yuan (12GB/256GB) to 5,699 yuan (16GB/512GB). Ace 7 Pro: 4,799 yuan (12GB/256GB) to 7,299 yuan (16GB/1TB). China's national subsidy lowers the starting price to 2,761.65 yuan for the Ace 7 and 3,149 yuan for the Pro.

items.name: Mistral Large 4 open weights
items.price: Free (open weights); API pricing not published
items.summary: Mistral released the open weights for Large 4 ('Le Chonk'), its 1-trillion-parameter model, on Oct 29, two days ahead of its ETA.
items.details: Previewed Oct 6 as a natively multimodal mixture-of-experts model (49B active parameters per token, 52B counting embeddings and output layers), trained on 3,800 NVIDIA Grace Blackwell GPUs in Mistral's European data centers. Mistral announced the weights release on Oct 29. The Next Web reports three more weeks of reinforcement learning since the preview (Terminal-Bench 4.0 up from 28% to 41%), new low and medium reasoning modes, and a quantized version that runs on four NVIDIA B200 or B300 GPUs. It is on Hugging Face, Mistral's API and for some Vibe users. Smaller distilled versions, including one for laptops, are planned with no dates. Rechecked Oct 30: the Hugging Face model page is live with downloadable weights, an NVFP4 quantized checkpoint and a 1M-token context.

items.name: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time (Switch 2)
items.summary: Nintendo's ground-up Switch 2 remake of Ocarina of Time is out, with rebuilt visuals, voiced cutscenes and a mic-playable ocarina.
items.details: Released Nov 5 as a Switch 2 exclusive (about 27 GB). Nintendo lists overhauled visuals, voiced cutscenes, expanded dialogue, orchestral music, reworked camera and movement controls, and the option to play Link's ocarina by humming or playing an instrument into the Switch 2 microphone. Buying digitally before Nov 23 adds a Zelda 40th anniversary wallpaper; new Young Link and Young Zelda amiibo come in 2027.

items.name: Pikmin 4: Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Dandori Academy
items.summary: The Switch 2 edition of Pikmin 4, with the Dandori Academy add-on, arrives Nov 12.
items.details: Date taken from VGC's release schedule.

items.name: Apple HomeView hub and Apple TV 4K (4th gen)
items.summary: Apple's new 7-inch HomeView smart-home hub and the Siri AI-enabled Apple TV 4K both arrive Nov 13.
items.details: Both devices were announced Oct 13 and are built to showcase Apple's upgraded Siri.

items.name: Microsoft Ignite 2026
items.summary: Microsoft's big AI, cloud and security conference runs Nov 17-20 at Moscone Center in San Francisco, with an online option.
items.details: Watch for Copilot and Windows AI announcements.

items.name: Grand Theft Auto VI
items.summary: Rockstar's GTA VI launches Nov 19 on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S; pre-orders opened June 25.
items.details: Digital preloading began on Nov 10 (TechRadar), a little earlier than the Nov 12 date reported before; the download is about 212GB. There is no PC version announced for launch. Rockstar says the game targets 30 fps on every console, with PSSR upscaling and ray-traced shadows on PS5 Pro (The Verge). Code-in-box retail copies arrive from Nov 12, and Microsoft says GTA VI streams on Xbox Cloud Gaming from day one (1 a.m. ET, Nov 19), including on Xbox One, using Series S settings.

items.name: Monster Hunter Wilds (Switch 2)
items.summary: Monster Hunter Wilds comes to Switch 2 on Dec 4.
items.details: Date taken from VGC's release schedule.

items.name: CES 2027
items.summary: CES 2027 runs Jan 6-9 in Las Vegas, with media days on Jan 4-5; expect new PC chips, TVs, laptops and gadgets.
items.details: CPU and GPU makers often use CES for launches. See the rumor tracker for what is expected from Intel, AMD and NVIDIA.

items.name: Intel Core Ultra 400 'Nova Lake-S' desktop CPUs
items.summary: Intel's next desktop CPUs are expected to debut at CES 2027 with first retail models in Q1 2027; Intel has not confirmed.
items.details: Intel CEO Lip-Bu Tan said on the Oct 29 earnings call that Nova Lake, Intel's first 18A-P client product, is 'tracking ahead of schedule' and that Intel will share more at CES in January. He did not give a launch or retail date. Earlier leaker claims and trade-press reports point to mass production in Q4 2026 and first retail models in Q1 2027. The 52-core flagship is expected later.

items.name: Samsung Galaxy S27 series
items.summary: Samsung has not announced it, but its past Galaxy S launches point to a Jan-Feb 2027 Unpacked with sales about two weeks later.
items.details: Past Unpacked dates: Jan 17, 2024; Jan 22, 2025; Feb 25, 2026. Four models are expected: S27, S27+, S27 Pro and S27 Ultra. On Oct 19 Korean tipster Lanzuk said Samsung plans an early January 2027 launch, earlier than the S25 and S26; see the rumor tracker.

items.name: OpenAI's first hardware device (Jony Ive)
items.summary: A court filing says OpenAI's first device won't ship before the end of February 2027; rumors point to a smart speaker with a camera.
items.details: OpenAI earlier said it would unveil a product in late 2026, which is a reveal, not a shipping date. Pricing and form factor are unconfirmed.

items.name: iPhone 18 and iPhone 18e
items.summary: Reports say Apple is splitting the iPhone lineup, with the standard iPhone 18 and 18e arriving in spring 2027; Apple has not confirmed.
items.details: The iPhone 18 Pro, Pro Max and the foldable were the fall 2026 models.

items.name: AMD Zen 6 desktop CPUs ('Olympic Ridge')
items.summary: AMD's next desktop CPUs are reportedly targeted for a CES 2027 reveal, with retail between March and June 2027.
items.details: AMD has not confirmed dates. Reports say the schedule slipped because of industry component turmoil.

items.name: Apple smart glasses
items.summary: Bloomberg's Mark Gurman reports Apple may unveil smart glasses at WWDC 2027 and ship late 2027, though it could slip to 2028-29.
items.details: Apple has said nothing publicly. This entry is a report, not an announcement.

items.name: Tesla Roadster (next generation)
items.summary: Tesla showed the new Roadster on Oct 15 and said consumer production begins in 2028; reservations reopened.
items.details: The flying 'Rocket' version using SpaceX-derived cold-gas thrusters is not expected to be street-legal. Engadget reports the thruster option requires a $250,000 reservation, and InsideEVs reports Tesla 'cannot guarantee' that pre-orders will ever be delivered.

items.name: BYD Seagull (2nd generation, China)
items.summary: BYD launched its bigger second-generation Seagull in China from 65,900 yuan, 4,000 yuan below the old model, with five-minute flash charging on upper trims.
items.details: Launched Oct 20 at the Zhengzhou International Circuit in five trims: Vitality (65,900 yuan), Freedom (72,900), Comfort (75,900), Flying (82,900) and Smart (99,900); trade-in buyers get 3,000 yuan off. The two cheaper trims have a 30.1kWh battery (320km CLTC) and an 85kW motor; the top three get a 39.2kWh pack (420km CLTC), a 95kW motor and BYD flash charging (10-70% in about five minutes at BYD stations), plus a year of free flash charging for private buyers. It is 425mm longer than before (4,205mm, 2,650mm wheelbase), seats five instead of four, switches to rear-motor rear-wheel drive with multi-link rear suspension, and adds a 94-litre frunk; the top trim adds roof LiDAR. Some export markets sell the Seagull as the Dolphin Mini or Dolphin Surf.

items.name: Samsung Galaxy F70 5G (India)
items.price: Rs 19,999 (4GB/128GB), Rs 22,999 (6GB/128GB); Rs 17,999 with launch offers
items.summary: Samsung launched the Galaxy F70 5G in India on Oct 18; first sales start Oct 20 at noon IST on Flipkart and Samsung's site.
items.details: It has a 6.7-inch 90Hz Full HD+ Super AMOLED screen with Gorilla Glass Victus, the Exynos 1330, a 50MP main camera with OIS, a 5,000mAh battery with 25W charging (charger sold separately) and a 7.5mm body, in Bold Black and Vivid Violet. Bank offers cut Rs 2,000 off at launch. Reports disagree on whether it ships with Android 15 or a newer One UI build.

items.name: Leapmotor A10s (China)
items.summary: Leapmotor launched a sportier-styled A10s small electric SUV in China with LiDAR and a 505km CLTC range.
items.details: Power, battery (53kWh LFP) and range match the existing A10 505 LiDAR trim; the A10s adds black paint and wheels, a red-stitched cabin and ventilated front seats for 6,000 yuan more. It uses Qualcomm's SA8295 cockpit and SA8650 driver-assist chips.

items.name: DeepSeek V4.1-Flash-1017
items.price: Open weights; also in DeepSeek's app and API
items.summary: DeepSeek shipped an updated Flash model in its app and API and as open weights, aimed at coding and agent tasks.
items.details: DeepSeek's own benchmarks show gains over the previous Flash and some larger rivals on coding and agent tests at a much lower cost per task; independent results are not out yet. DeepSeek also opened its in-house Search and Fetch APIs to developers.

items.name: Reflection Beam (501B open-weight model)
items.summary: US lab Reflection released Beam, its first model, as Apache 2.0 open weights on Hugging Face.
items.details: Beam is a text-only mixture-of-experts model with 501B total and 23B active parameters and a 1M-token context, built for coding and agent work. Self-hosting needs data-center GPUs (Hugging Face suggests four B200s for the 4-bit version); hosted inference providers also offer it.

items.name: NVIDIA RTX Spark Windows laptops (Surface Laptop Ultra and more)
items.summary: Laptops built on NVIDIA's RTX Spark chip began shipping Oct 16 from Asus, Microsoft, Lenovo, HP and Dell.
items.details: RTX Spark pairs a Grace CPU with a Blackwell GPU and up to 128GB of unified memory. Tom's Hardware lists prices from $2,599 (Asus ProArt P14) to about $7,000 for a 128GB, 2TB configuration. Small desktops are due later.

items.name: Amazon Bee Frontier and Bee Eclipse
items.summary: Amazon's Bee unit released the Frontier AI wearable, which turns conversations into summaries and to-dos; the phone-mounted Eclipse follows soon.
items.details: Frontier can be worn on the wrist or clipped on, with IP67 water resistance and up to seven days of battery. Eclipse is a credit-card-sized magnetic phone attachment with 21+ days of battery. Amazon says audio is deleted after processing and transcripts are encrypted with device-held keys; Bee can now connect to Alexa+ and Amazon.com shopping.

items.name: Gemini 4 Argon
items.price: API: $2 in / $10 out per 1M tokens until Nov 30
items.summary: Google's newest frontier model is available worldwide to developers and to Google AI Pro and Ultra subscribers.
items.details: API pricing rises to $4 / $20 per million tokens after the introductory period ends Nov 30, 2026.

items.name: BYD Da Han EV (China)
items.summary: BYD's new flagship electric sedan went on sale in China with up to 1,008km of CLTC range.
items.details: All three versions use a 102.3kWh second-generation Blade Battery that BYD says charges from 10% to 97% in about nine minutes on its fastest chargers. Prices came in below the pre-sale figures.

items.name: OnePlus 16 (China launch)
items.summary: OnePlus launched the 16 in China on Oct 12, among the first phones with a Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6-series chip.
items.details: Global plans were not announced at launch.

items.name: Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 and 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6
items.summary: Qualcomm announced two flagship phone chips at Snapdragon Summit; Motorola and Xiaomi were first with the Extreme version.
items.details: Phones using them are rolling out through late 2026 and early 2027.

items.name: Google Pixel 11, 11 Pro, 11 Pro XL and 11 Pro Fold
items.summary: Google's Tensor G6 phones went on sale Aug 20 at $899, $1,099 and $1,299 for the non-fold models.
items.details: The Pixel 11 Pro Fold released the same day, though not in every country.

items.name: Redmi K100 (China)
items.summary: Redmi launched the standard K100 in China on Oct 27 with a 10,000mAh battery and Snapdragon 8 Elite, from 3,499 yuan; sales start Oct 31.
items.details: List prices are 3,499 yuan (12GB/256GB), 4,099 yuan (12GB/512GB) and 4,499 yuan (16GB/512GB); Double 11 offers cut each by 500-600 yuan until Nov 11 (from 2,999 yuan), and China's national subsidy lowers it further in eligible regions. Pre-sales opened at launch and open sales start Oct 31 at 10 a.m. It pairs the Snapdragon 8 Elite with Redmi's D2 display chip (a first for a standard K model), a 10,000mAh silicon-carbon battery with 100W wired charging, a flat 6.83-inch 165Hz AMOLED screen, a 50MP main camera, IP68 and HyperOS 4. Earlier reports had suggested about 3,500 yuan, which matched the list price.

items.name: MiniMax M3.1 Flash
items.summary: China's MiniMax released M3.1 Flash, a fast, cheap model aimed at agents, coding and computer use, via its API and apps.
items.details: MiniMax says it runs about three times faster than its predecessor at 70% lower cost for agent tasks, with output above 200 tokens per second, and that it ran anonymously as 'Space Bunny' before launch. Available through the MiniMax API, M Plan and MiniMax Code. Weights come later, as does a larger 'Pro' model. Benchmark claims are MiniMax's own.

items.name: Faraway
items.summary: Steph Thirion's one-button cosmic arcade game, first announced in 2010, finally launches Nov 5 on PC, PS5, Xbox Series X|S and Switch.
items.details: Published by Annapurna Interactive. You guide a shooting star across a procedurally generated universe, linking stars into constellations and using their gravity to slingshot onward; it also has 16 handcrafted puzzle stages. The date was revealed by GameSpot. Released Nov 5; Steam lists it at $9.99 with a 20% launch discount, and it is also on Switch 2, Switch, PS5 and Xbox Series X|S.

items.name: AYN Odin 3 Portal (Android gaming handheld)
items.summary: AYN opened orders for its OLED Android handheld on Oct 23 from $399 (launch promo); shipping starts in early November.
items.details: Orders opened on AYN's store at 6:30 p.m. PT on Oct 22 (Oct 23 in Asia and Europe), and the base 12/128GB Black model was already backordered on launch day. AYN added a fourth configuration at launch: Max 16GB/1TB at $699 ($669 promo), alongside Base 12/128GB $419 ($399), Pro 12/256GB $499 ($479) and Max 16/512GB $579 ($549). Shipping starts in early November. It uses the Dragonwing Q8 (effectively a Snapdragon 8 Elite without a modem) with active cooling, a 7-inch 120Hz OLED, a 9,000mAh battery with 60W charging, Wi-Fi 7, DisplayPort output, rear paddles and microSD, running Android 15; it weighs 450g. Colors: Black, White and Cold Gray.

items.name: iOS 27.2
items.summary: Apple's first big iOS 27 update came out on Oct 26, adding Apple Pencil support on the iPhone Duo and Siri AI in more languages.
items.details: Apple released iOS 27.2 and iPadOS 27.2 on Monday, Oct 26, a week after the release candidate. It runs on every iPhone that supports iOS 27, including the iPhone Duo, which moves onto the same version as other iPhones (build 24B91020 on the Duo, 24B119 elsewhere). Highlights: Siri AI now works in French, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese and Spanish; AI suggestions in Messages that can create Calendar events or Reminders; Apple TV app profiles; a new Apple Music icon and look; FaceTime Dual Capture; and Apple Pencil (USB-C) support on the iPhone Duo. The rumored Apple Health redesign is not in it. Apple also shipped visionOS 27.2 and iOS 26.7.2 security fixes for older iPhones.

items.name: vivo Y600 (China)
items.summary: vivo's Y600 budget phone with a 10,000mAh battery and 44W charging went on sale in China on Oct 30, from 1,999 yuan.
items.details: Announced Oct 26 with pre-orders, on open sale from Oct 30. It has a 6.83-inch screen, the Dimensity 7300e, a 10,000mAh battery with 44W wired and reverse wired charging, a 50MP main and 8MP selfie camera and OriginOS 6 on Android 16. Prices: 1,999 yuan (6GB/128GB), 2,099 yuan (8GB/128GB), 2,199 yuan (6GB/256GB) and 2,499 yuan (8GB/256GB); China's national subsidy brings the base model to 1,699 yuan. Colors are blue, gold and black. It joins the Y600 Pro, Y600 Turbo and Y600i, and vivo says it set a Guinness record for the longest continuous livestream test of a phone (32 hours 37 minutes).

items.name: Denza N8 EV (China)
items.summary: BYD's Denza holds the launch event for the all-electric five-seat N8 SUV on Nov 12 in China, with up to 1,003 km of CLTC range.
items.details: Denza general manager Li Hui announced the timeline on Weibo on Oct 22: reservations open Oct 26 and the car officially goes on sale in November, with no launch day, prices or delivery plans yet. MIIT filings show single-motor RWD versions (320 or 370 kW) and a tri-motor AWD version with 890 kW combined; it is 5,150 mm long on a 3,075 mm wheelbase, 50 mm shorter than the six-seat N8L. Denza says it uses BYD's second-generation Blade battery with Flash Charging, and Electrek cites up to 1,003 km of CLTC range. Reservations opened on schedule on Oct 26: a 2,000-yuan deposit earns a 5,000-yuan option credit, but Denza has still not given a pre-sale price. For reference, the six-seat N8L starts at 299,800 yuan. Earlier reports had treated Oct 26 as the launch itself. Xinhua's Oct 28 report adds that the N8 comes as both an EV (RWD or tri-motor) and a plug-in hybrid (tri-motor only). As of Oct 31 Denza still has not named a launch day or price. Update Nov 6: Denza announced on Weibo that the N8 EV launch event is set for Nov 12, 2026 (via Electrek); prices are still not public, and the limited-time 5,000-yuan credit for a 2,000-yuan reservation continues.

items.name: Tesla Cybercab sales to customers
items.summary: Tesla said on its Q3 earnings call that it will start selling the steering-wheel-free Cybercab to customers by the end of 2026.
items.details: Tesla engineering VP Lars Moravy said current Cybercab production goes to Tesla's own robotaxi fleet, with customer deliveries starting small later. Musk said most Cybercabs will still be Tesla-owned and sold as transport-as-a-service. NHTSA opened an investigation in September into whether the Cybercab meets federal safety standards, which could affect the plan. On the same call CFO Vaibhav Taneja said Cybercab robotaxi service expands from Austin to Dallas next month and to more cities by year-end. Treat Tesla timelines with caution.

items.name: Tesla unsupervised FSD for owner cars (Robotaxi zones only)
items.summary: Tesla now targets Q2 2027 for unsupervised FSD in customer cars, but only by adding them to its Robotaxi fleet inside Robotaxi zones.
items.details: On the Q3 2026 earnings call, Tesla AI chief Ashok Elluswamy gave Q2 2027 and described the first step as owners adding their cars to Tesla's managed Robotaxi network, so cars would only drive unsupervised where Robotaxi already operates. Tesla has missed several earlier unsupervised-FSD targets.

items.name: Claude Duet (research preview)
items.summary: Anthropic announced Claude Duet, a proactive personal agent with its own iOS and Android apps, as a US research preview.
items.details: Duet runs on Opus 5.5 in its own virtual machine, sends a daily briefing of action items from connected apps, takes on tasks in the background and checks in before acting. For now it is a waitlist for US Claude subscribers; Anthropic says Pro ($20/month) subscribers get it at general availability. It competes with Meta Muse and OpenAI Dots.

items.name: Lenovo IdeaPad Vibe 14 (Snapdragon)
items.summary: Lenovo's Snapdragon IdeaPad Vibe, pitched as a MacBook Neo rival, went on sale a month early but at $799.99 instead of the promised $699.99.
items.details: TechRadar reports it is on Lenovo's own stores in the US, UK, Canada, the Eurozone, Malaysia and Singapore, with orders shipping from Oct 28. The US base model has 8GB of soldered RAM and 256GB of storage; other markets get 512GB. It offers two USB-C, two USB-A, HDMI and microSD, and comes in seven colors. The AMD version starts at $899.

items.name: Kimi K3.1 Pro
items.summary: Moonshot's upgraded Kimi K3 model is out in its apps and API, with a 2-3x faster Highspeed version and open weights promised by Nov 4.
items.details: Kimi K3.1 Pro is a post-trained version of the roughly 3-trillion-parameter Kimi K3 with a 1-million-token context window. Moonshot's own numbers put it at 65.7% on Terminal-Bench 4.0, ahead of GPT-6 Astra (58.2%) and just behind Claude Opus 5.5 (66.4%); these have not been independently checked. Moonshot says it removed cyberattack-related training data before the open-weight release. It is available on Kimi.ai, Kimi Work, Kimi Code and the Kimi API.

items.name: Kimi K3.1 Pro open weights
items.summary: Moonshot published the full Kimi K3.1 Pro weights on Hugging Face on Nov 4, the day it promised.
items.details: Moonshot released Kimi K3.1 Pro in its apps and API on Oct 23 and committed to releasing the full weights by Nov 4. The license terms have not been announced. As of Nov 1 there was still no K3.1 Pro repository on Moonshot's Hugging Face page (only the earlier Kimi K3). Checked again Nov 2 (about 14:00 UTC): Moonshot's newest Hugging Face repository is still Kimi K3 (last updated Sept 2); no K3.1 Pro weights yet. Checked again Nov 3 (about 14:00 UTC): still no K3.1 Pro repository; Moonshot's newest Hugging Face model is Kimi K3 (Sept 2). The deadline is Nov 4 with no time zone given, so we will check again next run before marking it Released or late. Checked again Nov 4 (about 14:00 UTC, already late evening on Nov 4 in China): Moonshot's Hugging Face organization still lists Kimi K3 (updated Sept 1-2) as its newest model, with no K3.1 Pro repository. If nothing appears by the end of Nov 4 UTC, we will mark the promise as missed next run. Update Nov 5: the weights are out. The public, ungated moonshotai/Kimi-K3.1-Pro repository went live on Nov 4 (ArtificialWatch saw it appear between about 14:30 and 15:31 UTC, just after our check): 96 safetensors shards totalling about 1.56 TB, MXFP4 weights trained that way, 2.8T total and 104B active parameters, a 1M-token context and text plus image input. The license matches the Kimi K3 terms: free use, modification and redistribution, but model-as-a-service firms with over $20 million in yearly revenue need a separate agreement, and very large products must display the model name. Moonshot kept its date.

items.name: iFlytek Spark-X2.6 (open-source)
items.summary: iFlytek released and open-sourced Spark-X2.6, a 293B-parameter mixture-of-experts model trained and served on Chinese chips.
items.details: Announced at iFlytek's 1024 Global Developer Festival in Beijing, Spark-X2.6 has 293B total and 30B active parameters and a 1-million-token context window, and runs on a domestic 10,000-card inference cluster. iFlytek claims coding and agent performance comparable to leading systems, which has not been independently verified.

items.name: Volkswagen ID. UNYX 09 (China)
items.summary: VW's second Xpeng co-developed EV, a large fastback sedan with 5C fast charging and up to 755 km CLTC range, launched in China.
items.details: Volkswagen Anhui lists three trims at 179,900, 219,900 and 249,900 yuan; the entry price is 20,000 yuan below the pre-sale price from Sept 24. A limited Double 11 price of 169,900 yuan applies to 500 black Ultra cars. The car is 5,081 mm long on a 3,030 mm wheelbase, and follows the ID. UNYX 08 SUV as the second model built with Xpeng.

items.name: Samsung Galaxy Buds On (South Korea)
items.summary: Samsung's first clip-style open-ear Galaxy Buds went on sale in South Korea on Oct 27 for 299,000 won; other markets come later.
items.details: Samsung says the Galaxy Buds On rest on the ear without blocking the canal, with Twin Boost speakers, sound-leakage reduction, automatic volume adjustment, three mics plus a bone-conduction sensor for calls, head-gesture control and up to 9.5 hours of playback. Korea gets one black model. Samsung has not set dates for other markets; European retail listings reported by Android Authority hint at the first half of December, which is unconfirmed. Update Oct 27: sales started on schedule via Samsung.com, online marketplaces and Samsung Stores; buyers through Nov 30 get two 30%-off accessory coupons. Update Oct 28: Samsung announced US availability in early November at $229 (black only); see the separate US entry.

items.name: Li Auto i6 (2026 model, China)
items.price: 249,800 yuan (239,800 yuan launch offer until Nov 30)
items.summary: Li Auto launched the 2026 i6 in China on Oct 28 at an unchanged 249,800 yuan, with its own M100 chip, a 96kWh in-house battery and deliveries from early November.
items.details: The five-seat electric SUV keeps the 2025 model's 249,800-yuan price, with a 10,000-yuan launch offer until Nov 30. Li Auto's in-house Mach M100 driver-assistance chip (1,280 TOPS) replaces Nvidia's Thor-U, with a dual-M100 option that adds three more lidars. The in-house Lianshan 5C LFP battery grows to 96kWh, raising CLTC range to 780 km (RWD) and 710 km (AWD). Inside, a 29-inch 6K panoramic screen replaces the twin 15.7-inch displays. Orders are open with deliveries in as little as 1-2 weeks. A European version (Li 6) is due in Norway and the Netherlands in Q1 2027.

items.name: Xpeng Mona L05 (China)
items.summary: Xpeng launched the Mona L05 SUV in China on Oct 29 with a limited-time starting price of 139,800 yuan, below its pre-sale price.
items.details: Six versions at launch: four battery-electric (up to 635 km CLTC) and two extended-range (310 km on battery, 1,310 km combined). Official guide prices run 144,800-176,800 yuan; buyers who pay a 5,000 yuan deposit by Dec 15 get 5,000 yuan off, for 139,800-171,800 yuan. Launch added a new entry 560 Plus BEV version, and the five pre-sale versions are each 15,000 yuan cheaper than their Oct 15 pre-sale prices. Max trims get one Xpeng Turing chip (750 TOPS) and the second-gen VLA Lite driver-assist model; Ultra SE trims get two chips (1,500 TOPS) and the full VLA model. It is 4,870 mm long on a 2,940 mm wheelbase, slotting above the Mona L03. Global shipments started Oct 26 for 65 countries and regions; overseas delivery dates are not set.

items.name: The Wolf Among Us Remastered
items.summary: Telltale's remaster of its Fables noir adventure launched Oct 29 on PC, PS5 and Xbox; the Switch version is still delayed.
items.details: Telltale announced the date and a new Noir Mode at Gamescom. It launches on Steam, the Epic Games Store, PS5 and Xbox; the Nintendo Switch version slipped to an unannounced date. It launched as scheduled on Oct 29 at $24.99.

items.name: STEINS;GATE RE:BOOT (consoles)
items.summary: The time-travel visual novel remake launched Oct 29 on Switch, Switch 2, PS5 and Xbox Series X|S in North America and Europe.
items.details: The PC (Steam) version came out on Aug 20. The console versions launched Oct 29, physical and digital in North America and digital in Europe. Correction: the UK/EU physical Standard and SteelBook editions for Switch 2 and PS5 move to Nov 3 (we previously listed Nov 23 in error). Prices are $59.99 for the Standard Edition, $69.99 for the SteelBook and $79.99 for the Digital Deluxe Edition.

items.name: iPad mini (A20 Pro, OLED)
items.summary: Apple's first OLED iPad mini is on sale from Nov 6: 8.5-inch OLED, A20 Pro and IP67, from $699.
items.details: Apple calls it the iPad mini's biggest update: an 8.5-inch OLED display (up to 1,200 nits peak, optional nano-texture on 256GB and 512GB models for $100 more), a 5.4 mm body with 24% thinner bezels, the 2nm A20 Pro, IP67 water and dust resistance (a first for an iPad), an 'Acoustic Display' speaker system, a landscape 12MP Center Stage front camera, Apple's N1 chip (Wi-Fi 7, Bluetooth 6) and C2 modem on cellular models. The 512GB model gets a 6-core CPU and a dual 16-core Neural Engine; 128GB and 256GB models get a 5-core CPU. There is still no ProMotion. Colors are midnight and starlight. The $699 start is $100 above the previous model. Pre-orders open Oct 28 at 10:10 a.m. PT in 36 countries and regions. As of Oct 29, AppleInsider reports most models still ship Nov 6; only cellular models with nano-texture slip, to 2-3 weeks. Update Nov 3: the first full reviews are out (Engadget, The Verge, 9to5Mac), praising the OLED screen and A20 Pro while flagging the higher price and the lack of ProMotion. Update Nov 6: MacRumors confirms the OLED iPad mini is available to buy from Apple's online store and Apple Store app today, with pre-orders arriving and units reaching Apple Stores and Authorized Resellers. Australia and New Zealand got the first in-store and delivery window as Nov 6 rolled west.

items.name: Poco X8s (global)
items.summary: Poco's compact X8s, with a 6.35-inch LTPO OLED screen and Snapdragon 7 Gen 4, launched globally on Oct 26.
items.details: The 1.5K 120Hz panel reaches 3,500 nits. Cameras are a 50MP main, a 50MP telephoto and an 8MP ultrawide, plus a 20MP selfie camera. It has a 6,330mAh battery with 100W charging, an ultrasonic fingerprint sensor, IP68 and Android 16-based HyperOS 3, in blue, black and white. Prices quoted are early-bird offers.

items.name: Infinix GT 50 Pro (India)
items.summary: Infinix launched its liquid-cooled GT 50 Pro gaming phone in India on Oct 27 at Rs 69,999, with a gaming accessory bundle thrown in for early buyers.
items.details: The single 12GB/256GB model costs Rs 69,999 (a Rs 5,000 bank discount brings it to Rs 64,999), in Black Abyss and Red Blaze. Pre-orders are open on Flipkart and Infinix's store and sales start Oct 30. Early buyers get a bundle Infinix values at Rs 24,999 (GT NX Controller, GT NX Station dock, GT MagCharge Cooler 2.0 and a MagSafe cover). Specs: 6.78-inch 1.5K 144Hz AMOLED (up to 4,500 nits), Dimensity 8400 Ultimate with LPDDR5X and UFS 4.1, HydroFlow liquid cooling with a micro-pump, pressure-sensitive GT Triggers 2.0 and a 6,500mAh battery with 45W wired and 30W wireless charging. Digit notes the price is almost triple the GT 30 Pro's Rs 24,999 launch price and links it to the memory shortage. The phone first launched in other markets in April.

items.name: 14-inch MacBook Pro (M6)
items.summary: The entry 14-inch MacBook Pro with M6 is on sale from Nov 6, starting at $1,999.
items.details: Announced by press release a day before Apple's Oct 28 'Pro and tell' launch. The M6 has a 12-core CPU (2 super cores, 4 performance, 6 efficiency) and a 12-core GPU, up from 10 and 10 on the M5, plus a dual 16-core Neural Engine; Apple claims up to 30% faster graphics and 25% faster AI work than M5. Memory bandwidth rises to 170GB/s, but MacRumors reports that applies only to 24GB and 32GB configurations, not the base 16GB. It adds Apple's N1 chip (Wi-Fi 7, Bluetooth 6), drives two external 4K displays at up to 165Hz, and Apple rates battery life at up to 24 hours. The design is unchanged (mini-LED Liquid Retina XDR, space black and silver), and it still starts with 1TB of storage. Pre-orders open Oct 28 in 35 countries and regions. As of Oct 29, most configurations still ship Nov 6, but AppleInsider reports nano-texture orders slipping (7-10 business days in silver, 3-4 weeks in space black). Update Nov 6: MacRumors confirms the M6 14-inch MacBook Pro is available to buy from Apple today alongside the rest of the Nov 6 lineup.

items.name: iMac (M6)
items.summary: The M6 iMac is on sale from Nov 6, starting at $1,499 for the 10-core model.
items.details: Announced Oct 27 by press release. The 24-inch 4.5K design and seven colors are unchanged. The M6 brings up to a 12-core CPU and 12-core GPU (two more cores each than M4) with Neural Accelerators in the GPU, a dual 16-core Neural Engine and up to 170GB/s memory bandwidth; Apple claims up to 5x faster on-device AI than M4. It adds Wi-Fi 7 and Bluetooth 6, up to 2x faster SSDs, and 2.5Gb Ethernet as an option on the 12-core model, which also gets four Thunderbolt 4 ports. Both base models have 16GB of memory and 256GB of storage. Pre-orders open Oct 28 at 10:10 a.m. PT in 35 countries and regions. As of Oct 29, AppleInsider reports every configuration still ships Nov 6. Update Nov 6: MacRumors confirms the M6 iMac is available to buy from Apple today.

items.name: GPT-6.1 Terra
items.summary: OpenAI's new mid-tier model, aimed at fast and cheap computer use, launched Oct 26 at half the API price of GPT-6.1 Sol.
items.details: Available to Plus, Pro, Enterprise and Edu users in ChatGPT Work and Codex, and in the API as gpt-6.1-terra ($1 per million input tokens, $0.05 cached, $5 output). OpenAI says it is a big step up from GPT-5.6 Terra in visual reasoning, computer use, factual accuracy and coding (50.3% on Terminal-Bench 4.0 at max effort versus 21.5%), finishes computer-use tasks over three times faster than GPT-6.1 Sol and GPT-6 Astra, and beats Sol on Terminal-Bench-Science, though Sol and Astra remain the better choice for the hardest coding. OpenAI rates it at the Critical cybersecurity threshold under its Preparedness Framework. These are OpenAI's own benchmark figures.

items.name: Acer Predator Atlas 8 (US launch)
items.date_label: Nov 1, 2026 (US, Best Buy; orders first opened Oct 23)
items.summary: Acer's 8-inch Windows gaming handheld with Intel's Arc G3 Extreme is on sale in the US as a $1,299.99 Best Buy exclusive.
items.details: Acer unveiled the Atlas 8 in May; the US gets only the more powerful Intel Arc G3 Extreme version, with Arc B390 graphics (12 Xe3 GPU cores), 24GB of LPDDR5X, an 8-inch 120Hz screen, TMR sticks, dual-mode triggers and Windows 11. It is Acer's first handheld sold officially in the US and costs the same as the Xbox Ally X20. Best Buy's pre-orders, opened last week, are sold out; Acer says online orders reopen Nov 1 alongside in-store sales. Update Nov 2: marked Released. IGN reported that Best Buy began taking and shipping orders on Oct 23, and Acer set Nov 1 as the official launch and in-store date. Best Buy's listing showed 'Sold Out' when we checked on Nov 2, so stock is tight; Acer has not said how many units are coming.

items.name: Samsung Galaxy Buds On (US)
items.summary: Samsung's clip-on Galaxy Buds On are on sale in the US from Nov 6 for $229.99, in black only.
items.details: Announced Oct 28, a day after Korean sales began. Samsung lists a TwinBoost speaker with sound-leakage reduction, automatic volume (a Labs feature), three mics plus a voice pickup sensor for calls, head gestures, Gemini Live and Bixby voice access, IP54 earbuds weighing 6.65g each, Bluetooth 6.2 and up to 9.5 hours of playback (38 hours with the case). Samsung's US product page and Android Authority give Nov 6 as the US on-sale date, in one black color and one size; they use Qualcomm's Snapdragon S7 Gen 1 Sound Platform. Update Nov 6: Android Authority and SamMobile report US sales are live at $229.99 from Samsung.com, Experience Stores and retailers. Update Nov 7: SamMobile's sources say the European launch comes in the third week of January 2027; Samsung itself has only said 'early 2027'.

items.name: Amazon Echo Dot, Echo Studio with Home Camera, Echo Time and Alexa Photo Frame
items.summary: Amazon launched a redesigned Echo Dot, a screenless Echo Studio with Home Camera, the Echo Time alarm clock and its first Alexa Photo Frame on Oct 28, all on sale now.
items.details: Built around Alexa Plus, which became available to everyone in the US in February. The new Echo Dot claims 50% more bass, faster on-device processing, an extra mic and Omnisense presence and temperature sensing. The Alexa Photo Frame has a 10-inch anti-glare touchscreen, works with Amazon Photos and doubles as an Alexa speaker, with voice notes attached to photos. The Echo Show 16 announced alongside them ships later (see its own entry). We have not listed prices here.

items.name: Amazon Echo Show 16
items.summary: Amazon's biggest smart display, the Echo Show 16, ships Dec 16; pre-orders opened Oct 28 with an early discount.
items.details: Amazon calls it its most powerful and best-sounding smart display: eight woofers and two tweeters, a VESA-compatible design, an optional pricier nanomatte screen, and the full Fire TV experience by touch. The Verge reports a $100 pre-order discount.

items.name: Google Genie 4 world model (research preview)
items.date_label: Oct 28, 2026 (trusted testers; AI Ultra in the coming weeks)
items.summary: Google DeepMind announced Genie 4, a real-time world model that adds generated sound and dialogue; it is a limited research preview for now.
items.details: Google says Genie 4 builds on Gemini Omni, keeps scenes consistent for up to two minutes (double Genie 3), lets users change weather, camera and objects with text prompts, simulates physics and human movement more realistically, and is its first real-time world model with native audio, including dialogue. Gemini 3.8 Flash can act as a guiding agent for multi-step prompts. Output is watermarked with SynthID. Access is limited to trusted testers; Google says it will reach Google AI Ultra subscribers in Project Genie and early-access Gemini API and AI Studio partners in the coming weeks.

items.name: Gemini 4 Carbon
items.summary: Google's top Gemini 4 model, announced Oct 28 for cyber defenders, reached the Gemini app (AI Ultra) and the paid Gemini API on Nov 10.
items.details: Google says Carbon ranks first on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v5.0 (59) and leads on vulnerability-finding, exploitation and patching benchmarks. Access starts this week with a subset of cyber defenders and expands through Google's Fairwind Program before reaching developers, businesses and consumers 'as soon as possible'; no date is set. Its introductory price matches Argon at $2 per million input tokens and $10 per million output tokens, rising to $4 and $20 later. Argon went from defenders-only to public in 13 days, but Google has not promised the same for Carbon. Update Nov 10: Carbon is now in the Gemini app, AI Mode and Antigravity for AI Ultra subscribers, and on the Gemini API paid tier in AI Studio and Android Studio; Argon stays available for AI Pro and up, and Gemini 3.1 Pro was removed from the app. The introductory $2/$10 price runs until Nov 30, then $4/$20 (9to5Google).

items.name: XREAL Aura (Android XR glasses)
items.date_label: Mid-Nov 2026 shipping (orders open Oct 28; Japan sale Nov 2)
items.summary: The first Android XR glasses, XREAL's tethered Aura, went on sale Oct 28 for $1,099 and start shipping in mid-November.
items.details: The 95-gram transparent glasses connect by cable to a compute puck running Android XR, with a 70-degree field of view, multiple virtual screens and Gemini. Orders are open in the US, Canada and South Korea; Japan sales start Nov 2 and wider availability comes next year. The launch prices of $1,099 and $1,299 run through the end of 2026 (regular prices $1,279 and $1,499), and XREAL says earlier pre-order buyers get the difference refunded.

items.name: Motorola Signature 27 (US)
items.date_label: Nov 19, 2026 (US; pre-orders open Nov 5); Nov 16 in Europe
items.summary: Motorola's Signature 27 is official at $1,599 in the US, with pre-orders open now and sales from Nov 19; Europe gets it Nov 16.
items.details: Unveiled at Qualcomm's Snapdragon Summit in September with the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 (Motorola's page calls it 'Extreme'). Motorola's US landing page says 'coming this November', and an India page now says the same. European retailer listings point to about EUR 1,595 (see the rumor tracker); Motorola has not given US pricing. Update Oct 30: Motorola said on X that it will show the phone on Nov 5; it has not said whether that is also the US on-sale date. Update Oct 31: a Signature 27 on Android 17 with 12GB of RAM appeared on Geekbench (3,313 single-core, 11,088 multi-core); Motorola has confirmed a 50MP Sony LYT 910 main camera, a 200MP periscope, a larger vapor chamber and seven years of OS updates, but still no US price or on-sale date. Update Nov 2: Motorola confirmed more specs through a sponsored preview with YouTuber Danny Winget, including a tandem OLED screen it rates at up to 12,000 nits peak, a 50MP Sony LYTIA main sensor with LOFIC, aluminum and ceramic materials and two Pantone colors. Price and US on-sale date are still expected on Nov 5. Update Nov 5: Motorola fully announced the phone. US: one 12GB/512GB model at $1,599, pre-orders open on Motorola.com, Best Buy and Amazon, on sale Nov 19, unlocked, in Coal Smoke and Capulet Olive, with a free Moto Watch Ultra as a pre-order offer; no Canada launch. Europe, Middle East and Africa: Nov 16, at a recommended EUR 1,899, though GSMArena says some retailers and partners will sell it for EUR 1,399. Specs: Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6, 6.8-inch tandem OLED (12,000 nits peak), 7,000mAh silicon-carbon battery with 90W wired and 50W wireless charging, 50MP main, 50MP ultrawide and 200MP 3x periscope cameras plus a dedicated event-vision 'action' sensor, IP68/IP69, 227 g, Android 17 with seven years of updates.

items.name: Witchbrook
items.summary: Chucklefish's witch-school life sim finally has a date: Jan 28, 2027, on PC, Switch, Switch 2, Xbox and PS5.
items.details: Dated at Nintendo's Indie World showcase on Oct 28 after slipping from 2025 and then 2026. You play a trainee witch at Witchbrook College in the seaside town of Mossport, alone or with up to four players online. Price has not been announced.

items.name: PS5 Prism Collection (transparent DualSense and console covers)
items.summary: Sony's see-through DualSense controllers and PS5 covers in orange, green and gray launch Feb 4, 2027, with pre-orders from Nov 10.
items.details: Announced Oct 28 on the PlayStation Blog. The Prism Collection comes in Flare Orange, Emerald Green and Graphite Gray, with clear shells that show the controller's internals and the console's fan. Controllers cost $84.99 / EUR 84.99 / GBP 74.99 and covers $74.99 / EUR 74.99 / GBP 64.99; covers are sold only directly by PlayStation where it ships. Sony has not said which PS5 models the covers fit.

items.name: Waymo robotaxi based on the Toyota bZ4X (Japan test fleet)
items.date_label: 2027 (Japan testing; UK and other markets later)
items.summary: Toyota will build a bZ4X robotaxi with the Waymo Driver installed at the factory; a test fleet starts in Japan in 2027.
items.details: Announced Oct 30, the first vehicle from the partnership the two companies signed in April 2025. Toyota builds the cars at its Takaoka plant in Aichi, with Waymo's hardware integrated on the same line. Rider changes include more rear legroom, automatic doors, a power liftgate and ambient lighting. 2027 is for testing and validation in Japan, where Waymo targets driverless commercial rides in Tokyo; the UK and other markets come later with no dates. No sensor specs, volumes or costs were given.

items.name: iOS 27.3
items.summary: Apple says iOS 27.3 ships to the public in December, bringing the first Apple Intelligence features to iPhones in China; developer beta 1 arrived Nov 3.
items.details: Apple confirmed the timing in an Oct 30-31 China Newsroom release, an unusual step for a point update. The beta starts Nov 4 China time (likely Nov 3 in the US, per MacRumors). Apple gave no exact December day. The China features exclude Siri AI and Image Playground; other iOS 27.3 changes have not been detailed. Update Nov 3: as of early morning Pacific time Apple had not yet posted the iOS 27.3 beta (Apple's developer releases page still tops out at iOS 27.2); MacRumors expects it later on Nov 3. Separately, Apple is testing a bug-fix iOS 27.2.1. Update Nov 4: Apple seeded iOS 27.3 beta 1 (plus iPadOS, macOS Golden Gate, watchOS, tvOS and visionOS 27.3 betas) on Nov 3. Besides Apple Intelligence in China, early hands-on reports list more Siri AI capabilities and new Siri AI languages, a redesigned Health app, Vertical Tabs and an adaptive dark mode in Safari, the iPhone Duo's StandBy design on iPhone 11 and later, Reachability for iPhone Duo, and Fitness+ Gym Strength plans. Features can still change before release.

items.name: Oppo Reno17 series, Pad Air 6 and Watch 5 (China)
items.summary: Oppo launches the Reno17 and Reno17 Pro in China on Nov 16, alongside the Pad Air 6 tablet and Watch 5.
items.details: Announced on Oppo's Weibo on Oct 30 without a date, prices or specs. Leaks point to a Reno17 and Reno17 Pro in China on ColorOS 17 (Android 17); Digital Chat Station tips the Pro with a 6.32-inch 1.5K 120Hz OLED, Dimensity 8550 Super, a 200MP main camera, 50MP periscope and about 7,000mAh, but those specs are unconfirmed. Update Nov 3: Digital Chat Station now tips the Reno17 with a 6.5-inch screen, Snapdragon 7 Gen 4 and an 8,000mAh-class battery, and the Reno17 Pro with a 6.3-inch screen, Dimensity 8550 and a 7,200mAh-class battery; both reportedly get a 50MP periscope, in 8GB/256GB to 12GB/512GB versions. Still a leak; Oppo has confirmed only a November launch. Update Nov 9: Oppo confirmed on Weibo that the Reno17 series, Watch 5 and Pad Air 6 launch in China on Nov 16, revealed the phones' design and four colors (Adventure Cat, Cocoa Brown, First Snow White, Ice Moon White) and opened pre-orders. Oppo also published the Pad Air 6 spec sheet ahead of launch: a 12.1-inch 2.8K 120Hz LCD (matte option), Dimensity 7360 Super, 10,050mAh battery, 8MP front and rear cameras, up to 12GB/256GB, Wi-Fi and LTE versions, ColorOS 17; pricing comes at launch. The Watch 5 is 9.2mm thick, 25g and rated for up to 7 days. Phone specs are still unannounced.

items.name: BYD Seal 07, second generation (China)
items.summary: BYD launched the larger second-generation Seal 07 in China on Nov 5 from 139,900 yuan, cheaper than before, with up to 775 km of EV range.
items.details: Auto Home reported the Nov 5 date on Oct 30 citing BYD, and BYD's Ocean sales chief said display cars had reached showrooms in 131 Chinese cities. The new car is 5,080 mm long with a 2,960 mm wheelbase, 85 mm longer than the Seal 07 EV that launched in March. Regulatory filings list 245 kW and 300 kW motors for the EV; BYD has previewed its second-generation Blade Battery, flash charging and roof LiDAR. The DM-i pairs a 1.5-liter turbo with a 160 kW motor and a 38 kWh pack (245 km WLTC electric range). Reservations opened Oct 26 without prices; the outgoing Seal 07 EV started at 169,900 yuan. Launch, Nov 5: five versions at 139,900-172,900 yuan (two DM-i plug-in hybrids at 139,900 and 149,900; three EVs at 149,900, 159,900 and 172,900), with 4,000 yuan off for eligible trade-ins. The EV starts 20,000 yuan below the March Seal 07 EV and uses a 245 kW motor and a 76 kWh second-gen Blade Battery (up to 775 km CLTC, 10-70% in 5 minutes on flash chargers); the DM-i gets up to 330 km of electric range. It is the first BYD-brand car with the Yunnian-M magnetorheological body control system, and roof LiDAR comes with God's Eye B.

items.name: Smart #2 (China launch)
items.summary: Smart's two-seat ForTwo successor went on sale in China on Nov 5 in a single Premium trim for 102,900 yuan, or 99,900 with launch incentives.
items.details: Yiche reported the Nov 5 date citing official information, and Smart's own China media site and IT Home carry the same date. The #2 debuted at the Paris Motor Show on Oct 12, when Smart put 999 Couture Edition cars on sale in China at 112,999 yuan. It uses a 35.8 kWh CATL LFP battery (up to 410 km CLTC), a 60 kW motor and 10-80% charging in 20 minutes, rides on the Electric Compact Architecture designed for tiny EVs, and is built by Geely in China for China, Europe and other markets. Prices for the regular versions come at launch. Update Nov 2: Smart says the 999-unit European Couture Edition (from EUR 25,690) sold out within two weeks of early orders opening on Oct 13; the regular Pure, Pure+ and Premium versions start at EUR 19,990 in Germany, France and Italy, with European deliveries planned for mid Q2 2027 (WLTP range up to 290 km). Launch, Nov 5: the regular car comes in one Premium trim at a list price of 102,900 yuan, with a 3,000 yuan launch incentive bringing it to 99,900 yuan, plus trade-in and repeat-buyer subsidies. The 999-unit China Couture Edition has sold out and delivers this year.

items.name: Xiaomi 18 Pro and 18 Pro Max (global launch)
items.summary: Xiaomi takes its 18 Pro and 18 Pro Max global at a Paris event on Nov 17, the first time its Pro models leave China.
items.details: The Xiaomi 18 Pro and 18 Pro Max launched in China on Sept 23 with dual 200MP Leica cameras, rear displays and Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 chips (Extreme Gen 6 on the Pro Max). On Nov 2 Xiaomi said on X that the series is 'going global this November', without a date or prices. Last year only the standard Xiaomi 17 left China. European retailer listings point to smaller batteries and prices from about EUR 1,399; see the rumor tracker. Reports suggest India may get only the 18 Pro. Update Nov 3: Xiaomi president Lu Weibing repeated the November timing on Weibo; still no date, markets or prices. Update Nov 9: Xiaomi confirmed the global launch for Nov 17 at an event in Paris at 13:00 UTC, streamed on YouTube and X, promising 'more surprises'. Only the two Pro models are named, so a vanilla 18 or an Ultra is not expected; GSMArena suggests the China-only Xiaomi Watch S5 41mm could appear. Global prices and battery sizes are still unannounced. Update Nov 10: a tipster on X (via GSMArena) says India gets only the 18 Pro, in December, and not the Pro Max; see the rumor tracker.

items.name: Meituan LongCat-2.5
items.summary: Meituan's new 1.6-trillion-parameter multimodal model for long agentic coding tasks is live in its demo and API, with weights promised soon.
items.details: LongCat-2.5 is a mixture-of-experts model with 1.6 trillion total parameters and about 48 billion active per token, built on LongCat-2.0 with native image understanding (images are turned into discrete tokens) and more long-horizon agent and coding training. Meituan says it was trained and served on domestic Chinese AI accelerators, including a 4-bit inference setup. Its own benchmark table compares it with GPT-5.6-Sol and Claude Opus 5; those are Meituan's numbers. The online demo and API are open now; Meituan says GitHub and Hugging Face weights will follow, and as of Nov 2 its Hugging Face page still tops out at LongCat-2.0. Checked Nov 3 (about 14:00 UTC): Meituan's Hugging Face organization still has no LongCat-2.5 repository.

items.name: RedMagic 12 Pro (global)
items.summary: RedMagic's liquid-cooled gaming phone with RGB lighting, a 185Hz screen and an 8,400mAh battery goes on sale worldwide Nov 18.
items.details: Announced globally on Nov 3 as the international version of China's RedMagic 12 Pro+. It has the Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6, a 6.85-inch 1.5K 185Hz OLED with an under-display 16MP selfie camera, RGB-lit dual-loop liquid cooling plus a fan, an 8,400mAh battery, 50MP main and ultrawide cameras, and IP68/IP69 ratings. The global model charges at 80W (120W in China). Prices are about EUR 200 higher than last year's RedMagic 11 Pro, and the top model drops from 24GB to 16GB of RAM. Early-bird vouchers sell Nov 12-17, voucher holders can order Nov 17, and open sales start Nov 18 in North America, most of the EU, the UK and parts of Asia Pacific, the Middle East and Latin America.

items.name: Stellar Blade Complete Edition (Switch 2)
items.summary: Stellar Blade Complete Edition is out globally on Nintendo Switch 2, with NieR, Nikke and Bayonetta content included.
items.details: Releases worldwide at the same moment: Nov 6 at 00:00 KST/JST, which is Nov 5 at 07:00 PT. The Complete Edition bundles the NieR:Automata and Goddess of Victory: Nikke collaborations and extra cosmetics. The physical cartridge holds the full game (not a game-key card). Four Bayonetta-inspired outfits arrive free on Switch 2, PS5 and PC the same day. Checked Nov 5 at about 14:15 UTC: still ahead of the 15:00 UTC (07:00 PT) unlock; launch-day coverage from GoNintendo confirms it is going live today. Update Nov 6: Shift Up's launch press release confirms the Complete Edition is now available worldwide on the Nintendo eShop, marking the series' Nintendo debut. A free demo is also live.

items.name: GAC Aion Ray 7 (China)
items.summary: GAC Aion's low-drag electric fastback with Huawei lidar and drive hardware officially launches in China on Nov 12.
items.details: Pre-sales began Oct 17 with five trims. The 4.96-meter sedan has a 0.22 drag coefficient, a Huawei DriveONE drive unit and a driver-assist system with a Huawei 192-line lidar and 27 sensors, using software derived from WeRide's robotaxi work. It uses LFP batteries in two sizes, rated at 530 km or 702 km CLTC. Final prices come at launch.

items.name: XBOX Nano Controller
items.summary: Microsoft's smallest Xbox controller, a $50 pocket-size pad aimed at kids, travel and cloud gaming, goes on sale Nov 4.
items.details: Announced Oct 14 on Xbox Wire, the Nano is just over 5 inches long and about 100 g, keeps all 18 standard inputs plus a programmable Action Button, and has a built-in rechargeable battery (Microsoft quotes up to 5 hours; USB-C cable sold separately). There is no rumble. It connects over Xbox Wireless to Xbox Series X|S and Xbox One and over Bluetooth to Windows, Android, iOS and some smart TVs, and a 'Cloud connect' preview can pair it over Wi-Fi for Xbox Cloud Gaming. Best Buy Canada listed the launch as Nov 4 and the Microsoft Store now sells it; Microsoft lists more than 30 launch countries for November.

items.name: Sonos 27voice AI assistant (US early access)
items.summary: Sonos opened US early access for its 27voice AI assistant on Nov 6; full release is planned for 2027.
items.details: The assistant handles playback, moving music between rooms, grouping speakers and timers, and Sonos says it understands looser natural-language requests too. Early access is limited, first come first served, US English only, and requested in the Sonos app; joining the waitlist does not guarantee a spot. It arrives alongside a Sonos app update that adds Presets, swipe-to-skip and System Health support. Update Nov 6: Engadget and Sonos support list early access starting today for approved US English users who request it in the Sonos app, with Presets and System Health landing in the same Sonos 27 update wave.

items.name: BYD's Guangzhou Auto Show debut (likely next-generation Han)
items.date_label: Guangzhou Auto Show, Nov 27-Dec 6, 2026 (model not yet named)
items.summary: BYD says it will show 'a model highly requested by customers' at the Guangzhou Auto Show; regulatory filings point to a larger next-generation Han sedan.
items.details: BYD Dynasty sales chief Lu Tian announced the debut on Weibo on Nov 2 without naming the car. CnEVPost links it to the next-generation Han, which appeared in China's MIIT filings on Oct 16 with three battery-electric versions (rear- or all-wheel drive, up to 520 kW combined) and one plug-in hybrid, at 5,156 mm long with a 3,030 mm wheelbase. The show runs Nov 27 to Dec 6, with Nov 27 as media day. The model identity and launch timing are not confirmed.

items.name: Tencent Hy4 (full release)
items.summary: Tencent's full Hy4 adds vision and computer use to its 770B-parameter model, available now through Tencent Cloud and OpenRouter.
items.details: Tencent released the full Hy4 on Nov 4, expanding the earlier text-only preview with native image understanding and computer use (command lines and desktop apps such as Blender and CAD tools). It is a 770-billion-parameter mixture-of-experts model with a 1-million-token context, tuned with Tencent's games unit for Unreal, Unity and Godot work. It is built into WorkBuddy, CodeBuddy and WeCom, with free access in WorkBuddy until Nov 15. Tencent says full weights will be published later and admits it still trails top closed models on hard visual QA, advanced math and long-horizon coding.

items.name: Baidu ERNIE 5.5 Flash Base (open source)
items.summary: Baidu open-sourced ERNIE 5.5 Flash Base, a 280B-parameter mixture-of-experts base model with 14B active parameters.
items.details: Released Nov 5. Pretrained on 33.5 trillion tokens with a 128K pretraining context, extendable to 1 million tokens for fine-tuning and inference. Baidu claims best-in-class scores for its size on knowledge, reasoning, math, code, multilingual and long-context benchmarks, ahead of DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Base and Hy3-preview-Base; those are Baidu's own numbers. It is a base model meant for building specialized models, not a chat assistant.

items.name: Nothing's first AI-native device (screenless)
items.summary: Carl Pei says Nothing's first AI-native product launches next month; it has no screen and 'couldn't have been an app'.
items.details: Pei announced the December timing in an essay posted on X on Nov 4, with a teaser image showing only rounded corners and curved edges. Nothing has not named the product or given its form factor, price or exact date, and pitches it as a productivity tool first. Earlier reports said Nothing is working on AI wearables, including smart glasses, but that is not confirmed as this device.

items.name: Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash
items.price: $0.07 per second (720p video); 30% cheaper than Omni 1.1
items.summary: Google's Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash is generally available with native 15-second video clips and 30% lower pricing.
items.details: Announced Nov 5 and made generally available on the Gemini API and Google Cloud. Clips go up to 15 seconds (from 10 on Omni 1.1), with one-second duration steps from 3 to 15, multi-turn conversational editing, stronger reference adherence, and more natural speech. Draft at 360p/720p then upscale to 1080p or 4K. Outputs carry SynthID watermarking. Also rolling into Flow, Google Vids, the Gemini app (AI Ultra) and Google Ads.

items.name: GPT-6 Cyber
items.summary: OpenAI launched GPT-6 Cyber, a restricted cybersecurity model rated Critical under its Preparedness Framework.
items.details: Announced Nov 5 for approved Daybreak Red customers via the API and Codex. OpenAI says it scores 48.5% on ExploitGym (up from 32.1% for GPT-5.6 Cyber), stays in scope in nearly all honeypot tests, and helped find 81 high-severity Firefox bugs and exploit 948 Linux privilege-escalation issues in research campaigns. Access starts with a select Daybreak Red group and expands later; GPT-5.6 Cyber is opening to all Daybreak Red customers.

items.name: Samsung Galaxy SmartTag 3 (US)
items.summary: Samsung's smaller Galaxy SmartTag 3 is on sale in the US from Nov 6 for $29.99, or $99.99 for a four-pack.
items.details: Android Authority reports US availability starting Nov 6 in white or black. Samsung markets a slimmer, lighter design than SmartTag 2, longer find range on the Galaxy Find network, and accessories such as a pet collar. It also works with iOS per earlier coverage.

items.name: Moto Watch 2 Fit
items.date_label: Coming weeks from Nov 5, 2026 (some markets: Moto Watch Fit 27)
items.summary: Motorola's Polar-powered Moto Watch 2 Fit fitness watch was announced Nov 5 and arrives in the coming weeks from €119.
items.details: Announced alongside the Signature 27 ecosystem push. 1.85-inch always-on OLED (1,500 nits, 60Hz), Gorilla Glass 3, IP68 and 5ATM, up to 12 days of battery, and Polar features such as Running Index, Nightly Recharge and Daily Activity Score. Colors: Stratified Sea, Pigeon and Ballerina. Selling in Europe, Middle East, Latin America, North America and Asia-Pacific; some markets use the name Moto Watch Fit 27. An Ask Anything / 'Hey Qira' AI coach is promised later.

items.name: Moto Buds 2 Ultra
items.date_label: Coming weeks from Nov 5, 2026 (some markets: Moto Buds Ultra 27)
items.summary: Motorola's Bose-tuned Moto Buds 2 Ultra earbuds were announced Nov 5 for €199, arriving in the coming weeks.
items.details: 11mm drivers with Bose SoundDesign tuning and Bose QuietControl ANC, Transparency Mode, Dolby Atmos with head tracking, AI live translation on compatible Moto phones, IP57, and up to 8 hours per charge (37 hours with the case). Same regional rollout as the Watch 2 Fit; some markets call them Moto Buds Ultra 27.

items.name: Samsung Intelligent Eyewear (Android XR glasses)
items.date_label: Pre-orders Nov 12, 2026 (US via Warby Parker); Gentle Monster collection launches in December
items.summary: Samsung's audio-first Android XR Intelligent Eyewear opens US pre-orders on Nov 12 through Warby Parker, with pricing still TBA.
items.details: Developed with Google; frames from Warby Parker and Gentle Monster. Android Authority and SamMobile say pre-orders open Nov 12, when the full collection, lens options and pricing are due. Shipping has been tipped for mid-December. Audio-first design first; display-integrated Samsung models come later. Privacy features include a recording LED that blocks capture if covered. Update Nov 6: Gentle Monster posted on X that its first Intelligent Eyewear collection 'launches this December', alongside a Joaquin Phoenix short film due mid-November.
