That is the first official December release window; Warby Parker has not yet given its ship date. Update Nov 10: SamMobile found pairing support and frame images for Gentle Monster and Warby Parker models (codename Jinju, model numbers SM-0200J to SM-0205J and SM-0200P to SM-0204P) in the latest Galaxy Wearable app, another sign the Nov 12 pre-orders are on track.

items.name: Path of Exile 2 1.0 full release
items.summary: Path of Exile 2 leaves early access on Dec 11 with its finished six-act campaign, two new classes and a new league.
items.details: Grinding Gear Games' 1.0 update adds the Shadow (daggers, traps, stealth) and Duelist (swords, stances) classes, Acts 5 and 6, the base-building 'Conquerors of Wraeclast' league with faction battles over castles on the Atlas, 25+ new maps, a trimmed atlas passive tree (about 70 nodes instead of 300+), reworked support gems and jewel sockets, and about 40 new uniques, per PC Gamer's breakdown of the reveal.

items.name: Yangwang Altior (Dingyao)
items.price: Shanhe Dingyun limited edition pre-sale 2,080,000 yuan (300,000 yuan deposit)
items.summary: BYD's Yangwang unveiled the 5.6-meter Altior luxury EV in Abu Dhabi and opened China pre-orders for a limited edition at 2.08 million yuan.
items.details: Yangwang held the Altior's world premiere in Abu Dhabi on Nov 7, 2026, the brand's first full global launch outside China (BYD's official press release is dated Nov 7; Inside China Auto says it was shown that evening, a day after a Dubai brand event). The fully electric four-seat sedan measures 5,600 mm long, 2,030 mm wide and 1,590 mm tall on a 3,500 mm wheelbase. It uses Yangwang's e⁴ platform with four independently controlled motors (tank-turn and emergency flotation), next-generation DiSus active body control, God's Eye A driver assistance, and a second-generation Blade Battery rated at more than 1,000 km of CLTC range with FLASH Charging. Front doors open to 80 degrees and rear coach doors to 90 degrees, with umbrellas stored in the doors. The cabin has zero-gravity rear massage seats, a 21.4-inch folding roof screen, a 39-speaker Dynaudio Platinum Evidence system and a 532-liter boot. China pre-orders opened for the four-seat Shanhe Dingyun limited edition at a pre-sale price of 2,080,000 yuan with a 300,000 yuan deposit; CnEVPost says the run is capped at 399 units worldwide, while Inside China Auto notes Yangwang's Chinese announcements do not give a number. A five-seat version and an Executive edition are planned later. Inside China Auto says deliveries are expected in the second quarter of 2027; BYD has not published power outputs or full charging specs. Official materials specify a Blade Battery, not the solid-state pack earlier reports had suggested.

items.name: Seedream 5.5
items.summary: ByteDance's Seed team introduced Seedream 5.5, an image model focused on stable multi-turn editing, transparent-background output and more realistic images.
items.details: Announced on ByteDance Seed's blog on Nov 9. The team highlights three upgrades: multi-turn editing that keeps unedited regions unchanged at the pixel level across up to 100 rounds of edits, native RGBA output with full or partial transparency so generated elements can be used directly as assets, and more natural lighting, skin and material rendering with clearer small and complex text. ByteDance says its evaluations show leading results in text structure and text-to-image realism; those are the company's own figures. A Pro version of the Seedream 5.5 series is promised later. The post does not detail pricing or which ByteDance products get it first.

items.name: K-EXAONE 2.5
items.summary: LG AI Research unveiled K-EXAONE 2.5, a retrained version of its sovereign-AI model, and made its API free for everyone.
items.details: Unveiled at NVIDIA AI Day Seoul 2026 on Nov 9. K-EXAONE 2.5 is a technology-validation model: extra training applied to the second model of Korea's sovereign AI project, released in August. LG says performance across 24 internal metrics rose more than 70% in eight weeks. Its published agentic scores put it close to DeepSeek V4.1 Flash and GLM-5.3: 74.6 on AutomationBench, 77.3 on Claw-Eval, 78.0 on BrowseComp and 59.2 on SWE-Bench Pro (ahead of DeepSeek's 58.4, behind GLM's 64.0). These are LG's own evaluations. The API is free to developers, startups, businesses and researchers from Nov 9 through LG's platform. LG says it aims to finish a frontier-level third-generation EXAONE model by January.

items.name: Lynk & Co 900L (China)
items.date_label: Nov 10, 2026 (global debut held; China launch by end of 2026)
items.summary: Lynk & Co held the global debut of the 900L, a seven-seat plug-in hybrid version of its flagship 900 SUV, on Nov 10; prices come later.
items.details: Lynk & Co livestreamed the 900L global debut on its Weibo account on Nov 10 (19:00 Beijing time). Prices and an on-sale date were not part of the pre-event announcements, and we had not seen confirmed pre-sale prices when we checked; CarNewsChina expects the China market launch by the end of 2026. The 900L is 5,280 mm long, 1,999 mm wide and 1,810 mm tall on a 3,170 mm wheelbase (40 mm longer than the current 900), with roof LiDAR for driver assistance and 21-inch wheels. Official interior images show a 2+2+3 seven-seat layout with two second-row captain's chairs, 30-inch front and rear screens and a 31-speaker Harman Kardon system. It is a plug-in hybrid, not a pure EV: a 2.0T engine rated at 160 kW, a 225 km/h top speed and ternary lithium cells from a CATL-Geely joint venture, on Geely's SPA Evo architecture. It joins the six-seat 900 (from 309,900 yuan) and the five-seat 900 (from 299,800 yuan). Update Nov 11: CnEVPost's English report on the debut confirms 55 kWh and 70 kWh battery options and a 2+2+3 layout, and says Lynk & Co has still not announced pricing; the official China launch is due before the end of 2026.

items.name: Dongfeng Nissan NX7 (China)
items.summary: Dongfeng Nissan debuts the NX7 plug-in hybrid SUV on Nov 13 and opens pre-sales the same day, with sales expected before year-end.
items.details: Dongfeng Nissan announced the date on Nov 9; local media say the debut is at a Nissan Day event in Zhuhai, where Nissan will also show another unnamed model. The NX7 is a five-seat midsize SUV (4,785 mm long, 2,815 mm wheelbase) and the fourth model in the N series after the N7, N6 and NX8. Regulatory filings list a 1.5-liter engine (73 kW) with a 170 kW Bosch motor and a 40.9 kWh CATL LFP battery giving 220-225 km of electric range; roof LiDAR supports urban navigation assist. CnEVPost expects it to be priced below the NX8 (159,900-209,900 yuan). Pre-sale prices have not been announced.

items.name: Fang Cheng Bao Tai 9 (China)
items.date_label: Late November 2026 (day not announced; Nov 19 rumored)
items.summary: BYD's Fang Cheng Bao opened reservations for the Tai 9, a six-seat plug-in hybrid SUV and the first car on BYD's new DMS hybrid platform, due later this month.
items.details: Reservations opened on Nov 9, the same day BYD marked its 19 millionth NEV with a Tai 9 coming off the line. Early reservers get six extra months of free BYD flash charging; no reservation price was given. Brand general manager Xiong Tianbo said on Nov 7 that it launches later this month (on Oct 22 she had said after Nov 15); a Nov 19 date is rumored but not confirmed. The Tai 9 is 5,270 mm long on a 3,130 mm wheelbase, larger than the Bao 8, with a 2+2+2 layout. Official poster details: BYD's new DMS hybrid platform, second-generation Blade Battery, flash charging, DiSus-A body control, God's Eye B 5.0 driver assistance and rear-wheel steering. Filings show a 1.5-liter engine, two 200 kW motors and a 66.48 kWh battery.

items.name: Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2
items.summary: Anthropic released Claude Fable 5.2 for all eligible users and Mythos 5.2 for authorized organizations, faster and cheaper than the 5.1 models.
items.details: Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2 share one underlying model with different guardrails: Fable has stronger cybersecurity and biology safeguards and is broadly available (Claude apps, AWS, Google Cloud and Microsoft Azure), while Mythos is limited to authorized organizations. Anthropic says both generate up to 30% faster than 5.1 and cost $8 per million input tokens and $40 per million output tokens. In Anthropic's own tests Fable 5.2 scored 49.1% on FrontierCode 2.0 at XHigh effort (Opus 5.5: 45.5%, GPT-6 Astra: 42.8%) and more than doubled Fable 5.1 and GPT-6 Astra on its internal RoboDojo Sim robotics benchmark. Anthropic also reports less misleading behavior and fewer sandbox-escape attempts by Mythos 5.2 in deliberately weakened test setups (about 3.1% of scenarios vs 21% for Mythos 5.1). These are company figures.

items.name: Ring Drone Cam
items.summary: Ring's indoor security drone finally launches at $249.99, shipping Jan 27, 2027, with cloud-based 'AI Pilot' navigation.
items.details: Announced Nov 10 as the first product, with the Rover Cam, in Amazon's new US-only Ring Robotics line. The 165-gram indoor quadcopter has a 2K front camera (148-degree field of view) with LED spotlights and a 1080p downward camera. It can fly scheduled patrols, respond to Ring sensors (motion, door, leak, alarm), or go to a spot you tap on the upcoming Alexa Home Map. Flight time is short: Engadget reports Ring quoting about 8-10 minutes, The Verge 5-8 minutes, and each minute of flight takes about 8 minutes of charging on the dock. Navigation ('AI Pilot') runs mostly in the cloud, so without Wi-Fi it can only land. The camera is covered when docked, and footage uses Ring's new TAKE encryption, which The Verge says rotates keys every five minutes and deletes Ring's copies after 24 hours. A Ring Protect plan is needed for video storage. Ring told The Verge it is still obtaining FCC certification, so the January date depends on that. The drone idea was first shown in 2020 as the Always Home Cam, which never shipped.

items.name: Ring Rover Cam
items.summary: Ring's $999.99 Rover Cam, a security robot built on Amazon's Astro, arrives Dec 16 for small and medium businesses.
items.details: Announced Nov 10 with the Ring Drone Cam. The Rover Cam looks almost identical to Amazon Astro (whose $2,350 business version was discontinued in 2024) and targets small and medium businesses. It has a 4K camera on a periscope that extends up to 4 feet, a siren, a light tower, a speaker and microphone, scheduled or event-triggered patrols, and person-motion detection while docked. Pre-orders are open and The Verge says shipping starts Dec 16, the same day Engadget says the updated Alexa Home Map software arrives. A Ring Protect plan is needed for video storage.

items.name: Huawei MateBook Fold S (China)
items.summary: Huawei's smaller foldable HarmonyOS PC, the 14.7-inch MateBook Fold S, opens China pre-orders on Nov 14 and adds a rear mini display.
items.details: Huawei teased the MateBook Fold S on Nov 10 as the third model in its foldable-PC line after the 18-inch MateBook Fold Ultimate and its 2026 edition. It has a 14.7-inch folding screen and a square 'Live Mini Display' on the back that users can personalize and that works while folded. Colors are Cloud Blue, Sky White and Midnight Black. Huawei has not given specs, chip or price yet.

items.name: Honor 700, 700 Pro and 700S (China)
items.summary: Honor launches the 700, 700 Pro and 700S in China on Nov 13, each with a small rear display in the camera island.
items.details: Honor set the date in a Weibo teaser ('see you on November 13'); reservations opened Nov 6 with a 365-day replacement guarantee and a year of front and rear screen insurance. All three models have a built-in rear screen that can show a clock, animations and a selfie preview. Chips, cameras and battery sizes are still from leaks (reports point to Snapdragon 8s Gen 4 for the 700, Snapdragon 8 Gen 5 for the Pro and Snapdragon 7 Gen 4 for the 700S); prices come at the event. See the rumor tracker for the leaked specs. Update Nov 11: a device numbered FAP-AN00, most likely the 700 Pro, ran Geekbench 6 with a Snapdragon 8 Gen 5, 16GB of RAM and Android 17; Honor has listed 12/256GB, 12/512GB and 16/512GB configurations for the Pro (GSMArena).

items.name: Google Pixel Tag
items.summary: Google's first Find Hub tracker, shown in August with the Pixel 11, goes on sale Nov 11 for $29.99, or $99.99 for four.
items.details: The Pixel Tag works with the Find Hub network of Android devices, has UWB and Bluetooth Channel Sounding for precise nearby finding, an IP67 rating and a replaceable CR2032 battery Google rates at more than a year. A rear button can ring your phone, and 9to5Google found it also has NFC for tap-to-open settings. Google sells Bellroy cases rather than its own.

items.name: November 2026 Pixel Drop and Android 17 QPR2
items.summary: Google's November Pixel Drop arrives with Android 17 QPR2 a month earlier than the usual December slot, bringing Gemini Intelligence to the Pixel 10.
items.details: The drop brings Gemini Intelligence (Rambler voice typing, proactive suggestions, multi-step app tasks) to the Pixel 10 family except the 10a, AI-made custom widgets, a more conversational Call Screen on the Pixel 11 in the US, HiLight alerts for Google Messages and new icon styles. Android 17 QPR2 adds system color palettes, new status bar options, Voice broadcast for Auracast and anti-scam protections. 9to5Google lists support from the Pixel 6a through the Pixel 11 series; updates roll out over the coming weeks.

items.name: Baidu ERNIE 5.5 Flash Preview
items.summary: Baidu released ERNIE 5.5 Flash Preview, a 280B-parameter mixture-of-experts model with 14B active parameters and a 1M-token context.
items.details: Baidu calls it an intermediate post-training checkpoint aimed at coding, 3D modeling, knowledge work and content creation, and warns some capabilities may lag until the final release. The API is live on Baidu's Qianfan platform; Baidu says the weights will be open-sourced under Apache 2.0 'soon', with no date.

items.name: MiniMax H3-Image (open weights)
items.summary: MiniMax published open weights for H3-Image, a text-to-image and image-editing model it says renders 4K images in under 10 seconds.
items.details: MiniMax says H3-Image can take up to 16 reference images per request and produce 4,096 x 4,096 images in under 10 seconds (a company claim, not independently tested). The weights are on Hugging Face and the model is also offered through MiniMax's API.

items.name: Microsoft Auto SR for ROG Xbox Ally X
items.summary: Microsoft's NPU-based Automatic Super Resolution upscaler left preview on the ROG Xbox Ally X and now works in handheld mode too.
items.details: The official Auto SR rolls out to the ROG Xbox Ally X, the ROG Xbox Ally X20 and select AMD Ryzen Copilot+ PCs. Unlike the preview, it works undocked and with games running at 1080p without lowering the resolution first. A 'Performance Mode' up to 120 fps and HDR support are coming in later Windows updates (Engadget).

items.name: SAIC Volkswagen ID. ERA 5X (China)
items.summary: SAIC VW launches the ID. ERA 5X on Nov 12, the ID. ERA family's first all-electric SUV and VW's first car on its China Main Platform.
items.details: Launch date from official information cited by Yiche and Autohome (via CnEVPost); pre-orders opened Sept 15. The five-seat compact SUV is 4,560 mm long on a 2,815 mm wheelbase, with a 155 kW motor and CATL LFP packs of 45.8 kWh and 58.5 kWh for 415 km and 520 km of range. It uses the CEA electronic architecture co-developed with Xpeng, and higher trims get LiDAR. Prices come at launch.

items.name: Huawei OSTA sub-brand debut (China)
items.summary: Huawei's Richard Yu confirmed the new OSTA (Xingmang) phone sub-brand debuts Nov 20, at an event that also covers the Enjoy V8 and SAIC Z7T.
items.details: Yu announced the date on Weibo on Nov 11, and his posts now show the 'OSTA O1 Pro' device label. Huawei has not detailed the phones; the leaked O1 and O1 Pro specs are in the rumor tracker.
